# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The adapter expects one BERT4Rec model per category. Its hooks expose catalog embeddings, bidirectional sequence features and candidate scores. Inference retains the latest L−1 history items, appends the reserved mask token, left-pads to L and reads feature index L−1. Several probes directly use feature–item-embedding dot products, assuming that scoring architecture.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual network through `view.model`, plus `item_emb`, `log2feats`, `predict_score` and public training histories. The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with B×L tensors. Optional consumed-record captures provide event traces and same-forward loss payloads; optional export hooks provide a runner and frozen artifact manifest.

`run_full_diagnosis` temporarily enables evaluation/inference mode, then restores module modes and Python, NumPy and Torch RNG states.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Integrity:** Checks reserved-mask identity, observed inference tokens, finite scores, live score agreement, padding invariance and negative controls. Required failures suppress history-sensitivity analysis; missing checks yield incomplete status.
- **Embedding collapse:** Rescales mean pairwise cosine among up to 2,048 catalog embeddings to [0,1]. Higher values indicate stronger angular alignment, not necessarily poorer recommendations.
- **Masked-target margins:** Reports positive-minus-negative mean, tenth percentile, negative-win rate and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower error rates indicate stronger training-target separation.
- **Consumed replay:** Reconstructs up to four captured batches and checks crops, event labels, masking, negatives and supported CE/BPR reductions.
- **Export audit:** Reloads the selected checkpoint on CPU and compares bounded fixtures against actual exported `predict` execution, recording score errors, rank disagreements, hashes and runtime.

# Perturbation & Tests

Integrity tests modify padding embeddings and right-context tokens, omit the mask and try an incorrect count−1 readout. Replay calibration injects verified label/mask faults and checks clean/permuted controls.

History sensitivity removes or masks oldest/newest blocks for up to 200 users. Fixed candidate sets across interventions measure score, rank, HR@10, margin and top-10 overlap changes, with separate candidate draws, strata and bootstrap intervals.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

The result contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`; the interpreter prompt requests status, findings, implications and evidence.

Training recovery does not establish held-out quality or causal preferences. Missing checks remain unknown. Bounded audits do not certify gradients, convergence, internal deployed readout or full-catalog simulator behavior. Unavailable item metadata stays empty; no four-category macro is inferred.
